import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod1 = 998244353L;
    static final long mod2 = 1000000007L;
    static long dfn, n, nLow, nAns;
    static long[] pw = new long[8];
    static List<Long>[] num = new ArrayList[7];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            num[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        pw[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 7; i++) {
            pw[i] = pw[i - 1] * 10;
        }
        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(num[i]);
        }
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        dfn = 0;
        nAns = 0;
        dfs2(0, 0);
        System.out.println(nAns);
    }

    static void dfs1(int dig, long x) {
        long tmp = (dfn + mod1 - x) % mod1;
        num[dig].add(tmp);
        nLow = (nLow + tmp) % mod2;
        dfn++;
        if (dig < 6) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                dfs1(dig + 1, x * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(int dig, long x) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if (x * pw[6] + pw[6] - 1 <= n && x * pw[7] > n) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long delt = (dfn + (mod1 - pw[i]) * x) % mod1;
                long idx = lowerBound(num[i], (mod1 - delt) % mod1);
                nAns = (nAns + ((delt + mod2 - mod1) % mod1) * pw[i] + mod2 * idx) % mod2;
            }
            nAns = (nAns + nLow) % mod2;
            dfn += 1111111;
            return;
        }
        nAns = (nAns + (dfn + (mod1 - x % mod1)) % mod1) % mod2;
        dfn++;
        int start = (dig == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        for (int i = start; i < 10; i++) {
            dfs2(dig + 1, x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static long lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }
}
